title: Everspin Executes $40M Agreement for Mil-Aero MRAM Applications
summary: Semiconductor Digest reports on Everspin’s $40 million agreement with a U.S. prime contractor to provide Toggle MRAM process technology, engineering support and foundry services for U.S. Defense Industrial Base programs. The two-and-a-half-year agreement will support military and aerospace applications that require reliable, long-life memory and a secure domestic supply. The article also notes Everspin’s foundry agreement with Microchip, which is expected to add U.S.-based manufacturing capacity for future MRAM production.
body_markdown:
Semiconductor Digest reports on Everspin’s $40 million agreement with a U.S. prime contractor to provide Toggle MRAM process technology, engineering support and foundry services for U.S. Defense Industrial Base programs. The two-and-a-half-year agreement will support military and aerospace applications that require reliable, long-life memory and a secure domestic supply. The article also notes Everspin’s foundry agreement with Microchip, which is expected to add U.S.-based manufacturing capacity for future MRAM production.


Read the full coverage at[Everspin Executes $40M Agreement for Mil-Aero MRAM Applications - Semiconductor Digest](https://www.semiconductor-digest.com/everspin-executes-40m-agreement-for-mil-aero-mram-applications/)
